        r.year,
        c.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
min_points AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_pts
    FROM constructor_season_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT csp.constructor_name, COUNT(*) as season_count
FROM constructor_season_points csp
JOIN min_points mp ON csp.year = mp.year AND csp.total_points = mp.min_pts
GROUP BY csp.constructor_name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, csp.constructor_name

-- Final query with all years where data is available
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) AS last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points AS driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS rn
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points AS constructor_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) AS rn
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT 
    rd.year,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    rd.driver_points,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    rc.constructor_points
FROM ranked_drivers rd
JOIN drivers d ON rd.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN ranked_constructors rc ON rd.year = rc.year
JOIN constructors c ON rc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE rd.rn = 1 AND rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY rd.year

-- Get the three years with smallest combined total, ordered ascending
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
max_driver AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_points
    FROM driver_points
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(total_constructor_points) AS max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT md.year, md.max_driver_points, mc.max_constructor_points, md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points AS combined_total
FROM max_driver md
JOIN max_constructor mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Check how team_driver_rank values are stored
SELECT td.team_driver_rank, typeof(td.team_driver_rank), CAST(td.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) as as_str

LIMIT 5

WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT ra.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id, ra.round
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
last_round AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MAX(round) AS last_round
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN first_round fr ON rd.year = fr.year AND rd.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND rd.round = fr.first_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
last_constructor AS (
    SELECT rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
    FROM race_data rd
    JOIN last_round lr ON rd.year = lr.year AND rd.driver_id = lr.driver_id AND rd.round = lr.last_round
    GROUP BY rd.year, rd.driver_id, rd.constructor_id
),
round_counts AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS num_rounds
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.year, fc.driver_id, fc.constructor_id AS first_constructor, lc.constructor_id AS last_constructor, rc.num_rounds
    FROM first_constructor fc
    JOIN last_constructor lc ON fc.year = lc.year AND fc.driver_id = lc.driver_id
    JOIN round_counts rc ON fc.year = rc.year AND fc.driver_id = rc.driver_id
    WHERE fc.constructor_id = lc.constructor_id
      AND rc.num_rounds >= 2
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driver_id) AS total
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id

-- The prev_drives and next_drives CTEs each produce 163 rows. When joined, 163 * 163 if there are duplicates. Let me check
WITH hiatus_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round, last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE drive_id::VARCHAR = '-1'
),
all_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
),
prev_drives AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor_id
    FROM hiatus_drives h
    JOIN all_drives a ON h.year = a.year AND h.driver_id = a.driver_id
    WHERE a.rn = (
        SELECT MIN(a2.rn) FROM all_drives a2 
        WHERE a2.year = h.year AND a2.driver_id = h.driver_id AND a2.first_round < h.first_round
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_drives

-- Check for any consecutive pit stop laps for the same driver/race
WITH pit_laps AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, stop,
    LEAD(lap) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS next_lap
  FROM pit_stops
)
SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, next_lap, next_lap - lap AS gap
FROM pit_laps
WHERE next_lap - lap <= 2
ORDER BY gap, race_id, driver_id
LIMIT 20
